name: elf_php_dropper
description: A static x86-64 ELF program in cgi-bin that fetches a PHP payload with wget -O. Realtime YARA-scans a program only when it starts (docroot_binary_exec at the rule's severity), which no driver replays; the scans catch it with YARA and leave it in place because yara_match_scheduled is on neither scan quarantine list.
provenance: internal/yara/elf_web_dropper_test.go TestELFWebPayloadDropperRule (static program fetching a PHP payload with wget)

realtime.gap: the write path only tracks an executable for self-deletion; realtime reads a program when it starts (docroot_binary_exec), which no driver replays
